7596.title: Claude session metadata becomes diagnostic events
7596.rootCauseOneLine: Two informational system subtypes are absent from the explicit visibility inventory, so the SDK-envelope fallback emits provider/unhandled events.
7596.proposedFix: Explicitly recognize session-title and application-discovery metadata as noise; preserve diagnostics for genuinely unknown subtypes.
7596.caveats: Deterministic provider-boundary reproduction in two clean checkouts; live CLI emission and desktop rendering were not exercised. The complete regression patch and failure output are inline in the report.
